in_sanskrit.name: अशुतोष
in_sanskrit.meaning: not having desire, not being desirous
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is not desirous of anything and is content with whatever he has. A name of Lord Vishnu.

in_hindi.name: अशुतोष
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who does not hold the desire for anything. A name of Lord Vishnu.

in_tamil.name: அஷுதோஷ்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who does not have the desire for anything and is content with whatever he has. A name of Lord Vishnu.

in_telugu.name: అశుటోష
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who does not have the desire for anything and is the lord of all desires. A name of Lord Vishnu.

in_marathi.name: Ashutosh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Hope, Wish, Desire
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ashutosh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ashu: Wish or Desire Tosh: Fulfilled or Complete

in_bengali.name: Ashutosh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Hope, Wish, Desire
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ashutosh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Ashu: Wish or Desire Tosh: Fulfilled or Complete

vedic_reference.note: Ashutosh is a name of Lord Vishnu in Hinduism, which means 'The one who is not desirous of anything and is content with whatever he has'. It is mentioned in various Hindu scriptures like the Vedas, Puranas, and Upanishads.
